title: Databases export feature to direct download files through Swagger.
body:
Me and my colleague (@GeoTsak314) came up with a solution that will speed up the exporting of files from database data through FastAPI Swagger.

The user just uses the endpoint
> /export?format= …


This is the sample code for JSON format:


```
from fastapi import FastAPI, Query
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
import pandas as pd


app = FastAPI()


# Sample data (connection with the dbase instead…)
data = [
	{"id": 1, "name": "Sebastián", "age": 30},
	{"id": 2, "name": "George", "age": 35},
 	{"id": 3, "name": "Joanna", "age": 22},
]



@app.get("/export")


async def export_data(format: str = Query("json", enum=["json", "... other formats to be"])):
	df = pd.DataFrame(data)

	if format == "json":
    	return JSONResponse(content=df.to_dict(orient="records"))


	elif format == "other formats to be...":
# Here will be new format to be…




	return JSONResponse(content={"error": "Invalid format"}, status_code=400)

```

answer.body:
Thanks for adding some extra context here! (apart from the email)

I think this would work better as part of a specific application that needs it, not as an internal feature in FastAPI.

I think the best way to proceed if you want that feature would be for you to write a blog post explaining your problem and your solution.

Now, if you want to contribute to FastAPI in general, the best way would probably be by:

* Reading the docs, studying them (they are written as a tutorial or book)
* Then helping others with their questions: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/help-fastapi/#help-others-with-questions-in-github

Helping others with questions would make you show up here after a month: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/fastapi-people/#fastapi-experts-last-month

Thanks for the interest! :cake:
